title: Jeeves. Reasoning improves Jev-like decision models
summary: Jeeves is PostHog's open-source project focused on improving LLM-like decision models through enhanced reasoning capabilities, likely aimed at creating better AI coding assistants or agents.
problem_solved: Improves how AI models reason and make decisions, addressing limitations in current LLM decision-making processes.
why_valuable: Better reasoning in AI models leads to more accurate, reliable, and contextually appropriate outputs for complex tasks like code generation and decision-making.
